standard.description: Balanced tournament structure with 100 big blind starting stack. Early levels allow deep play, mid-game increases pressure, late game forces action.

turbo.description: Fast-paced tournament with aggressive blind increases. High action, shorter game duration. Ideal for quick games and side events.

marathon.description: Deep stack tournament with slow blind progression. Allows for deep strategic play, longer game duration. Ideal for serious tournaments with large fields.
